name: Ivana Kovačić
bio:
Ivana's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. After years in international shipping, a chance encounter with a struggling rally team needing logistical support ignited a passion she never knew she possessed. Her meticulous nature and talent for problem-solving quickly made her indispensable, and she transitioned to Formula racing a decade ago. 

At Alpine F1, Ivana thrives on the fast-paced environment. She sees her role as more than just moving parts; it's about ensuring the team has everything they need, precisely when they need it, allowing them to focus on performance. Her colleagues appreciate her direct, no-nonsense approach and her uncanny ability to anticipate potential logistical nightmares before they arise. Her experience in international shipping gives her a unique perspective in motorsport logistics.

Ivana’s distinctive skill is her ability to find creative solutions to seemingly impossible logistical challenges. She’s not afraid to bend the rules (within legal limits, of course) and isn’t one to back down when told 'it can't be done.' Her tenacity and commitment to the team are highly valued.

physical.hairStyle: Short, practical bob, often pulled back with a clip
physical.description: Ivana is of medium height with a sturdy build, radiating competence and determination.

quirks: Always carries a small, well-worn Croatian-English dictionary.
Insists on using a physical planner, even though the team uses digital tools.
Secretly collects miniature models of transport vehicles.
